reviews.text: I have never used a peeling gel cleanser before, so I don't really have anything to compare this to. I've heard back and forth about these types of products, so I decided to try this and I was not disappointed. I use this on my face, arm pits and legs before hair removal and it makes my skin so soft. A gentle alternative to scrubs for sensitive skin. Best used on clean, dry skin. Lots of product within the tube, highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 我之前從來冇用過去角質嘅凝膠潔面產品，所以冇乜嘢可以比較。我聽過唔少人對呢類產品有唔同意見，所以決定試吓，結果冇令我失望。我喺除毛之前，會用喺面、腋下同腿上，用完皮膚變得好軟滑。對敏感皮膚嚟講，係磨砂產品嘅温和替代品。最好喺乾淨、乾爽嘅皮膚上用。條管入面產品好多，強烈推薦！

reviews.text: It does its job - your face after using will be like a glass, really soft and clean. With their acid toner it will make a magic and clean absolutely everything. My skin type is oily, but this helps sooo much with it. But when you put it on your face try to avoid eyebrows, I do not know why it is getting sticky there, but yes.
reviews.zh: 佢做得到嘢——用完你塊面會好似玻璃咁，真係超級軟滑、清潔。配埋佢哋嗰款酸類爽膚水，效果好神奇，乜都清潔得好乾淨。我嘅皮膚係油性，但呢款對我幫助好大。不過塗喺面上嗰陣要避開眉毛，唔知點解嗰度會黏，就係咁。

reviews.text: I’ve been using this product for a few months and wanted to wait and see any results I’m honestly very impressed with how well it works! I don’t use it often because it’s a face peel and I try to use it 2-3 times a week. I would recommend using a small portion because it dries up quickly and you have to peel it off but instead of peeling it little by little I use a sponge instead! It’s much easier to remove all of dead skin from your face. This product is really good and makes your face feel refreshed and soft (of course after moisturizing or using a toner which ever works for your skin type!)
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款產品幾個月，想等等睇吓會有咩效果，老實講我好欣賞佢嘅效果！我唔會經常用，因為佢係面部去角質膜，我會每星期用兩至三次。我建議用少少份量，因為佢好快乾身，要撕走，但我唔係慢慢一點點撕，而係用海綿擦！咁樣就容易好多，可以清走面上所有死皮。呢款產品真係好好，令面部感覺清新、軟滑（當然係塗完保濕霜或者爽膚水之後，用邊款就視乎你嘅皮膚類型！）

reviews.text:
This product was highly recommended from my friend and I just wanna say I LOVE IT!!!!!!

It removes the dead skin cells and gently exfoliates my face plus it removes the pores from my face especially the nose and chin area and gosh after I rinse my face with water it leaves my skin looking smooth plus soft as well.

I notice the difference before and after I use this product, my face has better complexion and better glowing skin.

ITS SO AWESOME !!!!!!!!

Would definitely recommend this product to my friends and family.
reviews.zh:
呢款產品係朋友大力推薦嘅，我只係想講我好鍾意！！！！！！

佢可以去除死皮，温和噉去角質，仲可以清理面上嘅毛孔，尤其係鼻同下巴位置。我用清水沖走之後，皮膚摸落又滑又軟。

我用呢款產品前後都見到分別，面嘅膚質更好，皮膚更有光澤。

好正！！！！！！！！

一定會推薦畀我嘅朋友同家人。

reviews.text: I usually like to try new products after being done with one but this works so well. I have been looking for something that will make my skin feel clean but won't leave me feeling dry. Unlike other people, my skin is not sensitive so I would have to use a lot of product. Now, I that I have this, I don't need to do that. It works well for me.
reviews.zh: 我通常用完一款就會試新產品，但呢款效果實在好好。我一直想搵啲可以令皮膚清爽，又唔會令我覺得乾燥嘅產品。同其他人唔同，我嘅皮膚唔係敏感肌，所以以前要用好多產品先夠用。而家有咗呢款，我就唔使咁做。佢對我好有效。

reviews.text:
That funny picture on the bottle is exactly how this product works: you are left with a new face 😁

To be honest I was skeptical to buy this product, but it is quite good. It peels off all dead skin, leaves my skin soft and even. Also you don’t need to use it more than once a week: I’ve tried second time in 3-4 days but there was no dramatic peeling effect because my skin was already fresh. I expect this bottle will last me a long time. 

On the other hand, I can’t say if it’s the best one out there. It is the first peeling gel I have used, so I have nothing to compare to.
reviews.zh:
樽上嗰個好笑嘅圖案，正正就係呢款產品嘅效果：你會得到一張新面孔 😁

老實講，買之前我都有啲懷疑，但係佢幾好用。佢可以撕走所有死皮，令皮膚軟滑、膚色均勻。另外你唔使每星期用多過一次：我試過第二次喺三至四日後用，但係冇咩明顯嘅去角質效果，因為我嘅皮膚已經好清爽。我估呢樽可以用好耐。

另一方面，我唔可以話佢係市面上最好嘅一款。呢個係我用過嘅第一款去角質凝膠，所以冇嘢可以比較。

reviews.text:
The product does have a very faint chemical smell, but I didn't expect any different when I purchased it. It's not overwhelming by any means, and if you use another skin product after using this, the smell of that will most likely be what you smell instead.
You only need to use a little bit of it at a time, since it's very effective even in small amounts. I don't recommend using too much at a time since it does so well removing dead skin!
I am very happy I bought this product and definitely will buy more in the future!
I highly recommend you try it out!
reviews.zh:
呢款產品有少少化學味，好淡，但我買嗰陣本身都預咗會係咁。佢唔會好濃烈，如果你用完呢款再用其他護膚品，最有可能聞到嘅係嗰款嘅味道。
每次只需要用少少，因為就算份量少都好有效。我唔建議一次用太多，因為佢去死皮嘅效果咁好！
我好滿意自己買咗呢款產品，將來一定會再買！
我強烈推薦你試吓！

reviews.text: This scrub is very soft with the skin, it does not irritate at all, it is perfect for sensitive skin, it removes dead skin cells from the face and I have noticed that it also diminishes the pores, the skin after applying it is soft, in my case I havent noticed the luminosity in the face but as the exfoliant is very good, I recommend moisturizing the skin very well after using it, because in my case I have a little dry skin, and the skin can dehydrate a little, for a little skin fats will come great, you can control the excess fat.
reviews.zh: 呢款磨砂膏對皮膚好温和，完全唔刺激，好啱敏感皮膚，可以去除面上嘅死皮。我留意到佢仲可以令毛孔睇落收細咗。用完皮膚好軟，但我自己就冇見到面部有咩光澤。不過因為去角質效果好好，我建議用完要好好保濕，因為我嘅皮膚有少少乾，用完會有啲脫水。如果皮膚有少少油脂，效果會好好，你亦可以控制多餘嘅油脂。
